Name: OBJ_ACT_PARAM_ST
Description: Object actions: the interactions on assets, such as doors and switches. Holds the prompt and failure messages, the conditions, the animations and the event timing.

Fields.Name: Action Enabled - Message ID
Fields.Description: Text shown for the action prompt while the action is available.

Fields.Name: Action Failed - Message ID
Fields.Description: Text shown when the action is attempted and fails.

Fields.Name: Condition Bypass Flag
Fields.Description: While this event flag is on, the special conditions are skipped and the action always passes them.

Fields.Name: Player Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the player plays for the action.

Fields.Name: Character Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation a non-player character, such as an enemy, plays for the action.

Fields.Name: Valid Distance
Fields.Description: Distance within which the action can be used, in cm.

Fields.Name: Conditional Qualified ID [1]
Fields.Description: ID checked by special condition [1]: a goods item or a SpEffect, depending on Qualified ID Type [1].

Fields.Name: Conditional Qualified ID [2]
Fields.Description: ID checked by special condition [2]: a goods item or a SpEffect, depending on Qualified ID Type [2].

Fields.Name: Object Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the object that marks the action position.

Fields.Name: Sync Event Trigger
Fields.Description: If ON, the events used to decide whether the ObjAct runs are synchronised. Normally OFF; set it ON only when the actor is not important.

Fields.Name: Object Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the object plays for the action.

Fields.Name: Valid Player Angle
Fields.Description: Angle within which the player can use the action: the allowed difference between the player's facing and the direction to the object.

Fields.Name: Qualified ID Type [1]
Fields.Description: Condition type for Conditional Qualified ID [1].

Fields.Name: Qualified ID Type [2]
Fields.Description: Condition type for Conditional Qualified ID [2].

Fields.Name: Valid Object Angle
Fields.Description: Angle within which the object accepts the action: the allowed difference between the object's action direction and the character's direction.

Fields.Name: Character Absorb Type
Fields.Description: How the character is pulled into the action position during the object action.

Fields.Name: Action Button Param ID
Fields.Description: ActionButtonParam row used for the action prompt.
